easyPrerequisites: There is a black card in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Xiahou Dun by sacrificing it.
When Xiahou Dun dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Xiahou Dun from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Xiahou Dun ability
Activate Xiahou Dun by sacrificing it.
When Xiahou Dun dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Xiahou Dun from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Xiahou Dun ability
Repeat
